who: Historian of the African diaspora at Howard University during the listed supervision years; PhD Howard 2005.

evidence.says: The authority for Quito Swan cites Black Power in Bermuda and identifies its author as an assistant professor of history at Howard University studying the African diaspora.
Howard's 2019 commencement report explicitly identifies Quito Swan as Kimberly Monroe's PhD supervisor.
The author's biography in this 2013 journal article states that Swan earned his PhD in African Diaspora History at Howard in 2005 and joined its history department in 2006.

notes: The authority's affiliation, matching doctorate, and direct confirmation of a listed student establish the match.

who: Historian of late antiquity and the medieval Middle East at Princeton; PhD Princeton 2010.

Princeton announced Tannous's history appointment beginning September 2012 and states that he earned his Princeton PhD in 2010.
The faculty profile lists Skyler Anderson, Walter F. Beers, Emily Chesley, Joseph Glynias, David Gyllenhaal, and Lucas McMahon among his advisees.

notes: The authority connects the expanded name to Jack Tannous; the doctorate and all six listed students agree.

who: Historian of Chicano, Mexican, political, and labor history at UCLA; history PhD UCLA.
